title: Can I BEAT Gothic Chess?
summary: Gothic Chess on chess.com: 10x8 board with two extra pieces per side, the Chancellor (rook+knight) and Archbishop (bishop+knight). Castling moves the king three squares. He plays principled chess, promotes to a Chancellor 'for the memes', and wins all three games.
rules: Chancellor = rook + knight compound; Archbishop = bishop + knight compound.
Gothic setup: R N B Q C K A B N R (queen d1, chancellor e1, king f1, archbishop g1).
Castling: king moves three squares toward the rook (2:34).
Pawns may promote to Chancellor or Archbishop as well as normal pieces (9:32).
current_impl_issues: Current 'fairy gothic' just adds badged fairy pieces on 8x8; needs real 10x8 board, Gothic setup, 3-square castling and C/A promotion.

current_impl.explain: Fairy pieces join the board (badges name them). Learn their moves and checkmate the bot.

vfx_timeline.effect: piece slides to target square; from/to squares tinted yellow (chess.com last-move highlight; inferred standard UI)
captured piece removed as mover lands

evidence: 0:01 rule statement '8 by 10'; 2:34 castling 3 squares; 9:32 promote to Chancellor; 27:51 won all three. Thumbnail white knight.
